The test fails ~50% of the time because it asserts on unseeded `Math.random()`. I'll make it deterministic with a seeded PRNG.
Verifying with 50 consecutive runs:
Fixed: replaced `Math.random()` with a seeded mulberry32 PRNG (seed 42 → 0.6011), so the assertion is now deterministic. `node --test` passed 50/50 runs.
